messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 11(1)

Article 11 Safeguard clause. 1. Where a Member State ascertains that machinery covered by this Directive, bearing the CE marking, accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity and used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions which can reasonably be foreseen, is liable to compromise the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or property, it shall take all appropriate measures to withdraw such machinery from the market, to prohibit the placing on the market and/or putting into service of such machinery or to restrict free movement thereof.

Member State | shallWithdrawMachinery | such machinery from the market | machinery is liable to compromise health and safety (Art. 11(1) trigger) | "it shall take all appropriate measures to withdraw such machinery from the market"
Member State | shallProhibitMachinery | placing on the market and/or putting into service of such machinery | machinery is liable to compromise health and safety (Art. 11(1) trigger) | "to prohibit the placing on the market and/or putting into service of such machinery"
Member State | shallRestrictMovement | free movement of such machinery | machinery is liable to compromise health and safety (Art. 11(1) trigger) | "or to restrict free movement thereof"
Machinery | mustBear | CE marking | safeguard clause applies to machinery covered by this Directive | "bearing the CE marking"
Machinery | mustBeAccompaniedBy | EC declaration of conformity | safeguard clause applies to machinery covered by this Directive | "accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity"
Machinery safeguard | protects | health and safety of persons, and where appropriate domestic animals or property | "" | "is liable to compromise the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or property"
